First, we apply the constant factor rule and take the coefficient $7$ out of the integral. Then we compute the integral of $\frac{1}{x},$ and get

$$
\begin{aligned}\int \frac{7}{x}\,\text{d}x & =7\int \frac{1}{x}\,\text{d}x \\ & =7\ln|x|+C.\end{aligned}
$$
